title: No automated base backups, WAL archiving or measured restore rehearsal

original_titles.title: No automated backup, WAL archiving, or tested restore
No automated backups, WAL archiving or restore drill

problem: BACKUP_AND_RECOVERY.md documents manual pg_dump and explicitly states automated backups, WAL archiving and a restore script are absent. Load and deployment readiness docs are still UNRUN.
impact: VM/storage loss can destroy submissions and scoring data since the last manual dump; advertised RPO/RTO are unproven.

verification.basis: Current source inspection at the main-branch commit listed in metadata. Original audit line numbers are treated as historical and were not reused as current line references.

implementation_steps.action: Choose a backup architecture: scheduled base backups plus continuous WAL archiving to a separate account/region or storage failure domain.
Encrypt backups with keys managed separately from the VM and DB; define access for two custodians and test access recovery.
Add automated archive continuity checks, backup freshness monitoring and alerts. Retain backup manifests and checksums.
Automate restore to an isolated scratch DB, apply latest WAL, then run foreign-key, ledger reconciliation, audit-chain and submission-count checks.
Run and time a full restore drill; record measured RPO/RTO, storage size, machine profile, run logs and sign-off.

acceptance_criteria: Successful timed restore from backup + WAL to a scratch DB.
Alert fires on missing/late archive segments.
regression_tests: Add a focused failing test before implementation where practical.
Add a negative authorization / boundary test, not only a happy-path test.
Run the affected backend/frontend suite and the full CI workflow before merge.
